title: PES 0110 writes a Manual Punch column as PE-DESIGN's Straight Block object
description: design.export with pesVersion 11 writes a shape.column (Manual Punch: direction lines) as the CEmbLine block object PE-DESIGN 11.50 writes for Manual Punch > Straight Block: one vertex per line end (the first ends in order, then the second ends back), each vertex its own handle, and the geometry header's two lists naming the lines' ends. The design is the owner's m01-straight-1 (crates/openstitch-formats/tests/fixtures/pe11/PROVENANCE.md, round 4 Manual Punch): clicks (10,10) (10,30) (30,10) (30,30) mm, one block, Satin in 007 PRUSSIAN BLUE, line not sewn.

evidence.note: docs/FILE_FORMATS.md, PES 0110 object list, Manual Punch: mapped from the owner's m01, m03-m05, m07, m08 and o-manual-*; the writer's rewrite of those files is byte-identical outside the documented differences (pes11.rs, written_object_sections_match_pe_designs_bytes_outside_the_documented_differences)

references.make: Run `stitchtool compat --only pes-0110-manual-punch` and open target/compat/work/pes-0110-manual-punch/a.pes in PE-DESIGN 11 (App menu > Open). Expected: one Manual Punch block object (10,10)-(30,30) mm, as the owner's m01-straight-1.pes: region Satin Stitch in 007 PRUSSIAN BLUE, line Not Sewn, Direction 'Manual straight line' with the angle greyed. Record in the MANIFEST notes: whether the file opens and with what warning, whether the object is a block (the Manual Punch points can be moved with Edit Points, the satin follows the two direction lines), and the status-bar size and stitch count against m01's (20,00 x 20,00 mm, 208 stitches). Then Save As PES, default type (Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 File, #PES0110), unchanged, under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md). If PE-DESIGN refuses the file or opens it blank, do not add a file: write what you saw in the notes of docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md instead.

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11's Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 file signature
m01-straight-1.pes: one CEmbLine block object; the reader parses the whole list
one Satin block in 007 PRUSSIAN BLUE, as m01
m01-straight-1: 20,00 x 20,00 mm; PE-DESIGN re-sews the block from the object
